why: Both sides make the same claims: X ↦ TX, Φ ↦ TΦ is a functor on ep-groupoids, TΦ preserves the structure maps, and T preserves tameness. They differ only in universe level. The project's tangentFunctor : EP.{max u 1} ⥤ EP.{max u 1} at u = 0 is an endofunctor of EP.{1}, the ep-groupoids on spaces in Type 1. B is stated for ep-groupoids in Type, whose tangents lie in Type 1. As B's author notes, an endofunctor on a single universe is not expressible there without the bundled EP. No EP.{max u 1} contains a Type-0 ep-groupoid, and the project has no ULift transport of ep-groupoid structures. So A cannot be specialized to B's objects, and B cannot be applied to A's objects. Both directions are therefore proved outright from non-item project lemmas, and neither uses its hypothesis, so neither is evidence for the audit. A_to_B gets (a) from the fields of tangentEpGroupoid (Theorem 8.1; IsProperMap gives B's IsProperB), (b) from EpFunctor.theorem_8_2, (c) from tangentMap_id / tangentMap_comp, and (d) from MPolyfold.IsTame.tangent. B_to_A uses rfl, rfl, tangentFunctor's map_id / map_comp fields and lemma_8_8. On the shared mathematics, the V8_13 round trip (Theorem 8.2) and the V8_11 round trip (tameness) do use their hypotheses and agree. The difference here is a universe artifact (the project's doc calls it 'an artifact of the formalization'), not a mathematical one.
B_issue: B states the functor componentwise from Type-0 ep-groupoids to their Type-1 tangents rather than as an endofunctor. Its author says this is forced, and it is the right reading of the text. It is not a bug, but it means B and the project's EP.{1} statement never share an instance.
overlap: B_to_A: 741 shared project theorems, nearly all reached through the statement. tangentFunctor in A's type brings in EP.tangent, tangentEpGroupoid (the whole Theorem 8.1 construction: lemma_8_2/8_3/8_7, isScSmoothComp_tangent, …), EpFunctor.tangent._proof_1–6, EpFunctor.id/comp/ext and tangentFunctor._proof_1–2. The proof itself adds lemma_8_8 → MPolyfold.IsTame.tangent (the V8_11 item's theorems, not banned here) and the map_id/map_comp fields of tangentFunctor.
